question: Should the final rebased head be authorized to ship `ws@8.21.0` as a runtime dependency of the bundled xAI plugin?
rationale: The runtime import is correctly plugin-owned, but repository policy intentionally prevents an external contributor from changing the shipped dependency graph without trusted review of the exact final SHA.

options.title: Approve the final dependency head
options.body: Inspect the resolved `ws` graph and authorize the exact rebased SHA through the dependency guard.

options.title: Regenerate dependency metadata internally
options.body: Keep the provider implementation while a trusted maintainer recreates the package and lockfile changes.

options.title: Pause the provider
options.body: Keep the PR open without landing until the runtime dependency can be approved or replaced.

recommendation.title: Approve the final dependency head
recommendation.body: Inspect the resolved `ws` graph and authorize the exact rebased SHA through the dependency guard.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current merged history across the Talk, gateway relay, realtime provider, and xAI integration surfaces and is best positioned to route the security/admin decision.
